newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Sept air travel passenger volume up 3.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: German Sept air travel passenger volume up 3.7 pct.

text.p: German air traveller numbers rose 3.7 percent to 11.4 million in September, the country's airports association ADV said.
This was a slight improvement on a 3.4 percent increase in August, its latest monthly traffic report shows.
Passenger numbers have risen 2.7 percent to 86.3 million over the first nine months of the year.
Travel to European destinations was up 5.9 percent at 6.4 million in September while passenger numbers for overseas destinations rose more slowly by 1.9 percent to 1.7 million.
Domestic German passenger numbers increased just 1.4 percent to 3.1 million in September, the report said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
